content.title: IAN Alert canceled after teen found safe
content.text: Skip to contentLEXINGTON, Ky. (WKYT) - UPDATE: The IAN Alert has been canceled.Kentucky State Police report that Jahmari Carter has been found safe and is being reunited with his family.According to KSP’s release, the person who identified Carter, recognized him from the alert on their cellphone. ORIGINAL: An IAN Alert has been issued for a teen last seen in Lexington.Kentucky State Police says Jahmari Carter, 17, was last seen on Monday at around 10 a.m. in the 400 block of Conley Street in Lexington.He is described as 5’ 7”, with brown hair and eyes, and is autistic, according to Kentucky State Police.Jahmari Deshaun Carter, 17(WKYT)Anyone with information is urged to call 911 or local law enforcement.IAN Alerts are used when children under the age of 18 with autism or mental illness go missing and may be in danger.Copyright 2026 WKYT.
